authority: User asked (2026-10-24) to implement lp_anyup's protected encoder schedule as a new arm, one seed as a test.
motivation: The parent U arm (block 23 peak 1e-6, blocks 20-23 only, 6,000 updates) moved the encoder by at most 0.03% relative and matched F. lp_anyup's protected schedule on the same encoder family (DINOv3 ViT-L/16) produced encoders that beat both the frozen pretrained encoder and stock Lightning Pose's schedule in few-shot transfer.

source_recipe.reference_run: inseption_model/run_lp_protected_vitl-dinov3_3576643 (head LR 5e-5, encoder cap 1e-5, LLRD 0.65, unfreeze epoch 10 of 60, 6-epoch warm-up from 0.1x, halvings at 36/48/54)
source_recipe.evidence: few_shot/home_heldout/summary.md: N=64 no-ear median 7.40 px protected vs 8.18 stock vs 9.92 frozen pretrained; few_shot/panomouse/full/summary.md: face N=100 34.8 px protected vs 66.4 stock

dev_reuse_disclosure: The DEV sets were already scored once for the parent F/U pair. This arm is specified from lp_anyup's recipe and the parent U's measured encoder drift, not from DEV scores; DEV is again scored only at the fixed updates below.
start: converged parent H0 EMA head (output/head_first_kp_20261024/H0_seed<N>/endpoint.pt) + released encoder; fresh AdamW and EMA for both branches

pair.FP: head only, identical to the parent F except the budget
pair.UP: head as FP plus the whole image encoder under the protected schedule
pair.clipping: head and encoder parameter sets clipped separately

protected_encoder.depths: 0 = patch_embed.proj + cls_token + storage_tokens; d = blocks.(d-1) for d = 1..24; final norm with depth 24
protected_encoder.ramp: geometric from 0.1 at update 1 to 1.0 at update 2001: min(1, 0.1 * 10**((u-1)/2000))
protected_encoder.envelope: the head's cosine envelope (floor 0.1), i.e. the encoder tracks the head's scheduled decay
frozen: attn.qkv.bias of all 24 blocks (release bias_mask is all zero)
cross-view aggregator, camera head, dense head
protected_encoder.forward: online encoder for every update, all blocks and the embedding in the autograd graph, bf16 autocast, features rounded to fp16 like the frozen cache
protected_encoder.guard: each encoder group is capped at the head current LR (parent rule: encoder LR always below the head); binds only while the head warms up (about updates 1-7 for the top group)

screening: parent screening rules (U-minus-F replaced by UP-minus-FP at update 12,000); one seed is a test, not a three-seed claim
